headline: Pinball's rescue now shows itself
lede: Resumed and shipped the kickback save sweep: when a kickback catches your ball, a light chases up the outlane it came home through and the rescue gets its own grapple sound — on both sides of both cabinets.

notes.text: #3766 shipped (PR #3776, 9d35638): gs.kbSweep ride the sim (display-only, hash-blind), renderer chases the save's own column, grapple voice gated against the ramp blip; pinballcheck §8c 10 pins + 6 named mutants, live pixel leg on an in-page rAF accumulator.
The build was a warden-killed corpse resumed at its last checkpoint (cf21b08) — verified green (342/342) and merged within the hour; checkpoint discipline paid for itself.

Prod verification lesson: games are route-split, so verify markers in the game's lazy chunk (Pinball-*.js), not index-*.js — and only object properties survive minification. Vercel posts on main as a commit status, not a check-run.
Also rode the PR: ADVENTURE gate-rite CLOSED audit mark and ROGUE lamp/oil BLOCKED mark (lamp is Moria-lineage, not Rogue 1980 — Wikipedia cited).
